text: At its meeting held March 9, 2022, City Council appointed Anne Milchberg and Janet Ross to the Sign Variance Committee for a term of office from March 10, 2022 to March 9, 2026, and until successors are appointed. These appointments fill the positions previously held by Irene Buncel and Nigel Waterman whose terms of office came to an end on March 9, 2022.
The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Received the letter (March 15, 2022) from the City Clerk.
